description.zh:
VPN网关的付费状态。取值：

- **Normal**：正常。

- **FinancialLocked**：欠费锁定。
description.en:
The billing status of the VPN gateway. Valid values:

- **Normal**: Normal.

- **FinancialLocked**: locked due to overdue payment.

description.zh:
VPN 网关类型，取值：
- Traditional：传统型VPN网关，覆盖IPsec功能和SSL功能
- Enhanced.SiteToSite：增强型站点入云VPN，只覆盖IPsec功能
description.en:
The type of the VPN gateway. Valid values:
- Traditional: traditional VPN gateway that covers IPsec and SSL features.
- Enhanced.SiteToSite: enhanced site-to-cloud VPN that covers only IPsec features.

description.zh:
是否包含未生效的订购数据。取值：

- **false**（默认值）：不包含未生效的订购数据。

- **true**：包含未生效的订购数据。
description.en:
Specifies whether to include pending order data. Valid values:

- **false** (default): does not include pending order data.

- **true**: includes pending order data.
The page number of the list. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。取值范围：**1**~**50**。默认值：**10**。
description.en: The number of entries per page for paging queries. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Default value: **10**.

description.zh:
VPN网关所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the VPN gateway. 

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query region IDs.

description.zh:
VPN网关所属的资源组ID。

您可以调用[ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~)接口查询资源组ID。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the VPN gateway belongs.

You can call the [ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~) operation to query resource group IDs.

description.zh:
VPN网关的状态。取值：

- **init** ：初始化。

- **provisioning** ：准备中。

- **active** ：正常。

- **updating** ：更新中。

- **deleting** ：删除中。
description.en:
The status of the VPN gateway. Valid values:

- **init**: initializing.

- **provisioning**: preparing.

- **active**: Normal.

- **updating**: updating.

- **deleting**: deleting.
The list of tags bound to the VPN gateway.

description.zh:
标签键。

一次最多支持输入20个标签键。
description.en:
The tag key.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time.

description.zh:
标签值。

一个标签键对应一个标签值。一次最多支持输入20个标签值。
description.en:
The tag value.

Each tag key corresponds to one tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values at a time.

description.zh: VPN网关所属专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）的ID。
description.en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the VPN gateway belongs.
The ID of the VPN gateway.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-gateways --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-bp1m3i0kn1nd4wiw90000 --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp17lofy9fd0dnvzv0000 --status active --business-status Normal --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --include-reservation-data true --tag Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --resource-group-id rg-acfmzs372yg0000 --gateway-type Enhanced.SiteToSite --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc DescribeVpnGateways --region cn-hangzhou --Status active --Tag.1.Key FinanceDept --VpcId 'vpc-bp1m3i0kn1nd4wiw90000' --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzs372yg0000' --VpnGatewayId 'vpn-bp17lofy9fd0dnvzv0000' --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value FinanceJoshua --GatewayType 'Enhanced.SiteToSite' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --BusinessStatus Normal --IncludeReservationData true
